name: Battery Monitor
description: Multi-device battery widget: iPhone battery (live) plus cached levels for standard BLE Battery-Service devices. Honest '--' for devices iOS does not expose to third-party scripts (e.g. AirPods).

localizedDescriptions.zh: 多设备电量小组件：实时读取 iPhone 电量，并缓存展示标准 BLE 电池服务设备的电量。对 iOS 不向第三方脚本开放的设备（如 AirPods）如实显示 '--'，不虚构数据。
